verdict.rationale: First-party material describes a desktop workspace where you launch work, track progress across multiple agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex), review changes, and merge. It also documents a centralized control page for jumping between agent sessions and checking progress, plus a single control plane for managing agents. All of this is vendor marketing or doc snippets rather than in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the unified multi-session workspace, and detailed docs on session management features such as concurrency limits and per-session controls.
